items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: I knew Lena Horne before she went into that.

ctx.x: memories of those kinds of things?
I remember the movie. I went to see it. I was glad. I enjoyed it because I guess, I knew Lena Horne before she went into that.
And, I think Bill "Bojangles" Robinson was in there. Right?
